answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the meadow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the grove of the next round. Reaching the willow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
